name: railway_list_projects
description: List the Railway projects the token can access, grouped by workspace: me { workspaces { id name projects { edges { node { id name } } } } }. Railway nests every project under a workspace, so projects live at data.me.workspaces[].projects.edges[].node — NOT at a top-level `projects` field (that returns empty for modern accounts). Each project `node.id` is what railway_get_project and the domain tools need; resolve a project name to its id here first. If a name is ambiguous across workspaces, use the id from the workspace the user means. Takes no parameters.

body_defaults.query: query { me { workspaces { id name projects { edges { node { id name } } } } } }
